1032.description: A machine curl done one arm at a time, so each biceps works independently.
instructions: Sit with your upper arms resting on the pad and grab the handles.
Curl one handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower it slowly while curling the other arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid swinging.

1096.description: External rotation using straps. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
instructions: Hold the handles with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Lean back slightly.
Rotate your forearms outward and upward.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Return slowly.
Keep the motion small.

1160.description: A full-body move: squat, kick back to a plank, push-up, jump up. It builds endurance and strength.
instructions: Start in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and placing your hands on the floor in front of you.
Kick your feet back into a push-up position.
Perform a push-up, keeping your body in a straight line.
Jump your feet back into the squat position.
Jump up explosively, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly and immediately lower back into a squat position to begin the next repetition.
instructionsZh: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖并将双手放在身前的地板上，将身体降低至蹲姿。
将脚踢回到俯卧撑位置。
进行俯卧撑，保持身体呈一条直线。
将双脚跳回蹲姿。
爆发性地跳起，将双臂举过头顶。
轻轻落地并立即回到蹲姿，开始下一次重复。

1224.description: A standing overhead press on the Smith machine. The fixed bar path lets you focus on pushing.
instructions: Set the bar at shoulder height and stand under it with a shoulder width grip.
Unrack the bar and hold it at your collarbone.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders slowly.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.

1288.description: One-arm dumbbell fly with your upper back on a stability ball. It stretches and shapes the chest while your core keeps you steady.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with a dumbbell in one hand and your feet flat on the ground.
Walk your feet forward and roll your body down until your upper back is resting on the exercise ball.
Extend your arm with the dumbbell straight up above your chest, palm facing inwards.
Slowly lower the dumbbell out to the side, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
Pause for a moment, then squeeze your chest muscles to bring the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，一只手拿着哑铃，双脚平放在地上。
双脚向前走，身体向下滚动，直到上背部靠在健身球上。
将手臂伸直，将哑铃举至胸部上方，手掌朝内。
慢慢地将哑铃向一侧放低，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
暂停片刻，然后挤压胸部肌肉，使哑铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1352.description: Lie face down and lift your chest off the floor in a curling motion. It strengthens the lower back with a gentle bodyweight movement.
instructions: Lie flat on your stomach with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, and slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling your back upwards.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸直，双臂放在身体两侧。
收紧臀肌和腿筋，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向上弯曲背部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1416.description: Lie face down over a stability ball with one leg lifted and rotate it slightly. It strengthens the glutes and hips while your core balances.
instructions: Lie face down on the stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your legs extended straight behind you.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you for support.
Engage your glutes and core muscles to stabilize your body.
Slowly lift one leg off the ground, keeping it straight and parallel to the floor.
Rotate your leg outward, away from your body, while keeping your hips and upper body stable.
Pause for a moment at the end of the rotation, then slowly return your leg to the starting position.
Repeat the rotation with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面朝下躺在稳定球上，臀部放在球上，双腿伸直在身后。
将双手放在身前的地面上以获得支撑。
调动你的臀肌和核心肌肉来稳定你的身体。
慢慢地将一条腿抬离地面，保持笔直并与地板平行。
向外旋转腿部，远离身体，同时保持臀部和上半身稳定。
旋转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将腿放回起始位置。
用另一条腿重复旋转。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

1480.description: A stretch that opens the front of the arm and chest by reaching the arms behind you.
instructions: Stand tall and reach both arms behind your back.
Straighten your elbows and turn your palms down or clasp your hands.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body until you feel a stretch in the biceps.
Keep your chest open and your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.

1544.description: A stiff-legged deadlift with a wide stance that brings in the inner thighs and glutes. It also keeps the hamstrings under a deep stretch.
instructions: Take a wide stance, toes slightly out, with the barbell held in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees nearly straight and push your hips back.
Lower the bar between your legs while keeping your back flat.
Stop when you feel a strong stretch in the hamstrings and inner thighs.
Squeeze your glutes to rise back to standing.

1608.description: A standing curl with an overhand grip on a cable SZ bar. It targets the brachialis and forearms.
instructions: Attach an SZ bar to a low pulley and grip it overhand with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Stand tall with your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl the bar up while keeping your wrists straight.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and keep your torso still.

1672.description: A one-arm Zottman curl over a preacher bench: curl up palm up, turn the palm down to lower. It works biceps and forearms.
instructions: Sit on a preacher curl bench and hold a dumbbell in one hand with an underhand grip.
Rest your upper arm on the preacher bench pad, allowing your arm to fully extend.
Curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
At the top of the curl, rotate your wrist so that your palm faces up.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position, rotating your wrist back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在牧师弯举凳上，单手握哑铃，反握。
将上臂放在牧师凳垫上，让手臂完全伸展。
将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，保持上臂静止。
在卷曲的顶部，旋转手腕，使手掌朝上。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置，同时将手腕旋转回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1736.description: A one-arm French press on an exercise ball. It trains the triceps and tests balance.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing up and your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your arm straight up towards the ceiling, keeping your elbow stationary.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝上，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
将手臂伸向天花板，保持肘部不动。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1800.description: Holding a cable attachment, you lean back and let your weight stretch your lats and back. Good for opening up the upper body.
instructions: Hold the cable attachment or handles with both hands at about chest height.
Lean back with straight arms and sit your hips back until you feel your back lengthen.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1864.description: A steeper decline sit-up that increases the load on the abs.
instructions: Set a decline bench to a steep angle and hook your feet under the pads.
Lie back and cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly back down.

1928.description: A stretch using a wall bar to flex the ankle and lengthen the muscles of the lower leg.
instructions: Stand facing the wall bars and place the front of one foot against a low bar.
Lean your body forward and press your heel toward the floor until the lower leg stretches.
Hold the bars with your hands to stay balanced.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1992.description: A hack squat on a sled machine through a full range of motion, loading the quads and glutes.
instructions: Set your shoulders under the pads and your feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Unlock the safety and straighten your legs.
Lower your hips slowly until your thighs are below parallel.
Keep your back flat against the pad and knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your whole foot to stand back up.

2120.description: Uses a stick held overhead to guide a deeper side bend, stretching the flank and the lats.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a stick with both hands overhead.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lean your torso slowly to one side without twisting.
Keep your hips steady and your chest facing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to upright and lean to the other side.

2312.description: A floor crunch that brings elbow to opposite knee. Works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the ground, bringing your right elbow towards your left knee.
At the same time, extend your right leg straight out and lift it off the ground.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time bringing your left elbow towards your right knee and extending your left leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，将右肘靠近左膝盖。
同时，将右腿伸直并抬离地面。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
重复该动作，这次将左肘移向右膝盖并伸展左腿。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

2760.description: A hip thrust with a resistance band over the hips, adding load that increases toward the top.
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the band over your hips, anchored at both sides.
Plant your feet flat.
Drive your hips up against the band.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

2952.description: A kneeling glute kick using a Smith machine with a partner helping. It works the glutes with a steady guided path.
instructions: Get on all fours and place the sole of one foot on the Smith bar, with your partner steadying you if needed.
Brace your core.
Press the bar up by extending your hip.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

3016.description: A curl-up lifting your shoulders off the floor. Works the abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3144.description: A seated straight-back row using a resistance band. Builds the upper back and lats.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and loop the resistance band around your feet.
Hold the ends of the resistance band with your hands, palms facing each other.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly back, engaging your core.
Pull the resistance band towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在地板上，双腿伸展，将阻力带绕在脚上。
双手握住阻力带的两端，手掌相对。
保持背部挺直，稍微向后倾斜，锻炼核心肌群。
将阻力带拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3272.description: Combine running in place with a half squat jump for a cardio drill that also trains the legs.
instructions: Stand tall and run on the spot for a few steps.
Drop into a half squat with your chest up.
Jump up, swinging your arms.
Land softly with bent knees and go back to running.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.

3336.description: A v up while holding a dumbbell, raising your arms and legs together to challenge the abs.
instructions: Lie flat with legs straight and a dumbbell held in both hands overhead.
Brace your core.
Lift your arms and legs together, forming a V shape.
Touch the dumbbell near your shins.
Lower back down slowly without dropping your legs.

3400.description: A dumbbell clean followed by an overhead press for total-body power.
instructions: Stand over two dumbbells and grip them with a flat back.
Pull the weights up explosively and catch them at your shoulders.
Dip slightly and drive them overhead.
Lock out your arms.
Lower to your shoulders, then to the floor with control.
Keep the weights close to your body.

3464.description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 4 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

3528.description: A downward dog flowing with gentle spine movement. It loosens the back and hamstrings.
instructions: Start in a downward facing dog.
Bend one knee, then the other, pedaling gently.
Shift your hips side to side.
Let your spine twist a little.
Keep your hands pressed into the floor.
Breathe slowly.

3656.description: A run with short, quick strides. It raises the heart rate and builds foot speed.
instructions: Find an open space or a treadmill to perform the exercise.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Start jogging in place, lifting your knees high and pumping your arms.
After a few seconds, start taking short strides forward, maintaining a quick pace.
Continue running with short strides for the desired duration or distance.
instructionsZh: 找一个空地或跑步机来进行锻炼。
站直，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
开始原地慢跑，抬起膝盖并挥动手臂。
几秒钟后，开始小步前进，保持快速的步伐。
继续小步跑所需的时间或距离。

3720.description: Explosive jumps up a flight of stairs that build leg power and speed.
instructions: Stand at the bottom of a staircase with your feet together.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up onto a step, landing softly with both feet.
Step back down carefully.
Reset and repeat.

3784.description: A push-up with your hands crossed under your chest. It puts extra load on the triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands crossed under your chest.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor with your elbows close.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Switch which hand is on top each set.

3848.description: A seated row using a towel for resistance. It trains your lats and upper back.
instructions: Sit with your legs extended and loop a towel around your feet.
Hold the ends with arms straight.
Pull the towel toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly.

3912.description: A bent-over one-arm cable raise that hits the rear delts.
instructions: Stand next to a low pulley and bend forward at the hips with a flat back.
Grab the handle with the far hand.
Raise your arm out to the side with a soft elbow.
Lift to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after your reps.

4040.description: Reverse lunge holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest. The bar adds load and encourages an upright torso.
instructions: Hold the bar end against your chest with both hands.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your front heel down and your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return, then switch legs.

4104.description: A bent over row using a trap bar, working your back and arms with a neutral grip.
instructions: Stand in the trap bar and hinge forward with a flat back, gripping the handles.
Brace your core.
Row the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar with control.

4168.description: A single leg squat to a box followed by a jump. It builds balance and explosive leg strength.
instructions: Stand in front of a box on one leg, other leg forward.
Squat down on one leg to touch the box.
Drive through your heel and jump upward.
Land softly on the same leg.
Control your balance and reset.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

4232.description: Wrist curls with palms down while seated, using a weight. They build the muscles on top of the forearm.
instructions: Sit with your forearms on your thighs, palms facing down.
Let your hands hang over your knees holding weights.
Lower your wrists to stretch the forearms.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can.
Lower slowly.
Keep your forearms still on your thighs.

4296.description: A kneeling lunge stretch with a cross-body reach to deepen the stretch along the front of the hip.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge, on a mat.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and keep your torso upright.
Reach the arm on the kneeling side up and across toward the opposite side.
Shift your hips gently forward until you feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

4360.description: A harder bench dip with your feet on a second bench. It places greater load on the triceps.
instructions: Place your hands on one bench behind you and your heels on another in front.
Straighten your legs and lift your hips.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Press back up.
Keep your back close to the bench.

4424.description: A bodyweight row under a rack-mounted barbell with a close overhand grip, targeting the upper back and lats.
instructions: Set a barbell in a rack at about waist height.
Lie beneath it and grip the bar overhand with hands close together.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Pull your chest to the bar and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower with control.

4488.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the top inner shoulder blade (levator scapulae). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your top inner shoulder blade (levator scapulae) while lying on your back on the floor.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4552.description: A lunge stepped out at an angle that trains the legs and hips in a different plane, with a quick, springy pace.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot out diagonally, about 45 degrees away from you.
Bend both knees and lower into a lunge, keeping your chest up.
Push off the front foot to return to the start.
Alternate legs each rep.
Keep your front knee pointing the same way as your toes.

4616.description: A standing leg swing forward that warms up the hip flexors and hamstrings and challenges your balance.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out for balance or hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto one foot.
Swing the other leg forward and up in a controlled kick, keeping it fairly straight.
Lower it with control without leaning back.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

4680.description: A standing triceps pressdown using a band. It isolates the back of the arms.
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and hold the ends with both hands.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Press your hands down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Let your hands rise slowly and repeat.

4744.description: A chest-supported row on an incline bench with your head resting on the pad. It targets the upper back without loading the spine.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest your head on the top of the bench and let your arms hang.
Pull your elbows back and the dumbbells toward your ribs.
Pause and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

4808.description: Raising your legs while lying on your back. It works the lower abs and the hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping before your back arches.
Keep your legs as straight as you comfortably can.
Breathe steadily through each rep.

4936.description: A bodyweight squat with a wide stance and toes turned out. It trains the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out.
Hold your hands in front of your chest.
Sit down between your legs.
Keep your chest up and knees over the toes.
Push through your heels to stand.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.

5064.description: Hold dumbbells at your shoulders from a half-kneeling position and rise to standing. It builds single-leg strength, hip drive and balance.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front and hold dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Drive through the front foot to stand tall.
Lower back down under control to half kneeling.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

5128.description: Squeezing your shoulder blades together while seated. It strengthens the upper back and improves posture.
instructions: Sit tall with arms at your sides or elbows bent.
Draw your shoulder blades back and together.
Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds.
Release slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Repeat for your reps.

5192.description: A weightlifting combo where a clean flows into a front squat and a push press. It trains power and stamina together.
instructions: Start with the barbell on the floor and pull it to your shoulders in a clean.
Stand up with the bar racked on your shoulders.
Squat down into a deep front squat.
Drive up and press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulders and repeat.

5384.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the thoracic spine. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under your upper back, arms crossed.
Place the roller under the thoracic spine and let your body weight settle onto it.
Lift your hips and roll up and down the upper back.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5448.description: A short seated row focusing on pulling your shoulder blades together. Isolates the mid back.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your chest on the pad.
Grip the handles overhand with arms straight.
Pull your shoulder blades together without bending your elbows much.
Hold for a second.
Let your shoulder blades spread slowly.
Avoid shrugging toward your ears.

5576.description: Plate-loaded machine press on an incline, one arm at a time, for upper chest.
instructions: Sit on the machine and grip one handle.
Keep your back against the pad.
Press the handle up and forward until the arm is nearly straight.
Lower slowly with control.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

5704.description: An explosive lift from the hang position that brings the bar to the shoulders. It trains power through the hips, legs and traps.
instructions: Hold the bar at mid-thigh with an overhand grip and a flat back.
Hinge slightly so the bar sits just above your knees.
Jump and shrug explosively, extending hips and knees.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower the bar back to the hang.

5896.description: The basic standing pose with a tall, balanced posture. A base for most other poses.
instructions: Stand with your feet together or hip-width apart.
Spread your toes and press evenly through both feet.
Lengthen your spine and draw your shoulders back and down.
Let your arms hang with palms forward.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.

6024.description: A prone move where you alternate kicking each bent leg up, to work the glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms under your forehead.
Bend one knee to 90 degrees with the sole toward the ceiling.
Lift that thigh off the floor by squeezing the glute.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips on the floor.

6152.description: A single-arm snatch that takes a dumbbell from the floor to overhead in one motion. This version uses the left arm.
instructions: Stand over a dumbbell with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip it with your left hand and hinge at the hips.
Drive up with your legs and hips.
Pull the dumbbell up close to your body and punch it overhead.
Lock out the arm.
Lower the weight back to the floor with control.

6344.description: A static squat hold that builds endurance in your thighs and glutes and teaches a solid bottom position.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit down into a squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then stand up.

6600.description: A squat where you hold on to a support to stay balanced, ideal for learning depth and form.
instructions: Hold on to a sturdy support at chest height.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat.
Keep your chest up and your heels down.
Stand back up by pushing through your feet.

6792.description: A quick posture check to see whether one shoulder sits higher than the other.
instructions: Stand relaxed with your feet hip-width apart and arms hanging loose.
Look straight ahead and let your shoulders settle naturally.
Check in a mirror, or ask a friend, whether both shoulders are at the same height.
Roll the shoulders once and re-check without shrugging.
Note any difference and repeat now and then to track it.

7176.description: A seated machine calf press that pushes through the balls of the feet. It builds the calf muscles.
instructions: Sit in the machine and place the balls of your feet on the platform.
Extend your knees almost fully.
Press up as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly for a good stretch.

7560.description: Squat on one leg, building strength and balance.
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other lifted in front.
Extend your arms for balance.
Lower down with control.
Keep your knee over your toes.
Push up and switch legs.

7624.description: A deep lunge-based hip opener with a twist and reach, stretching the hips and inner thighs.
instructions: Start in a low lunge with your front foot between your hands.
Lower your forearms to the floor or blocks.
Drop your back knee or keep it lifted.
Let your hips sink.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Step back and switch sides.

7880.description: A kickback done in a kneeling position, with one hand on a bench for support.
instructions: Kneel beside a bench with one hand and the same-side knee on it.
Hold a dumbbell in the free hand with your upper arm against your side.
Extend your elbow to kick the weight back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

8200.description: Seated, you press your palms together in front of your chest. It trains the chest with no equipment.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair.
Bring your palms together in front of your chest.
Press your palms firmly into each other.
Hold for 10-15 seconds.
Release and repeat.

8712.description: A hip hinge on a plate-loaded machine that trains the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Stand in the machine and grip the handles with a flat back.
Keep a soft bend in your knees.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back as you lower.
Stop when you feel the hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.

9608.description: Walking backwards at a gentle pace on a treadmill. It works the quads and gets your heart rate up in a joint-friendly way.
instructions: Set the treadmill to a very slow speed and hold the handrails.
Turn to face away from the direction of the belt.
Step back gently, landing on the toes first.
Keep your chest tall and take small steps.
Continue for several minutes at a comfortable pace.

9928.description: A single leg kickback lying on an incline with a cable. It focuses on the glutes.
instructions: Lie on an incline surface with the cuff on one ankle.
Hold the support for stability.
Kick your leg back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

10056.description: A landmine press with a band adding extra resistance on the way up.
instructions: Set up a landmine with a band attached and hold the end of the bar at your shoulder.
Stand with feet staggered and core braced.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it to your shoulder under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

10120.description: A single leg step up with cable resistance that builds leg strength and balance one side at a time.
instructions: Face a box with the cable handle held at your chest or by your side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel and stand up straight on the box.
Lower your trailing foot back to the floor slowly.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

10184.description: A Pallof press from a split stance that resists the band pull and trains anti-rotation strength.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand sideways to it in a split stance.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the band straight out in front of you without letting your torso turn.
Hold for a second, then bring the hands back to your chest.
Switch which foot is forward on each set or rep and keep your hips square.

10760.description: A walk on your toes with a band around your feet. It builds calf and ankle strength.
instructions: Place a band around your forefeet or ankles.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Walk forward in small controlled steps.
Stay high on your toes.
Keep your hips level.
Walk for 20-30 steps.

11016.description: A one-arm overhead press from a half kneeling stance. It trains the shoulder while the position challenges your balance and core.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front, and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height.
Brace your core and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Press the dumbbell straight overhead until your arm is extended.
Lower it under control back to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

11272.description: A combo of a biceps curl flowing into an Arnold press with cables. It works arms and shoulders in one fluid move.
instructions: Hold low cable handles, palms forward, arms down.
Curl the handles up to your shoulders.
Rotate your palms inward as you start to press.
Press overhead, turning your palms forward.
Reverse the move and lower under control.

11656.description: Gentle walking in place in chest-deep water, a low-impact way to move the legs and raise your heart rate.
instructions: Stand in waist-to-chest-deep water with your feet hip width apart.
Lift one knee up in front of you, then lower it and lift the other.
Swing your arms naturally and keep your posture tall.
Walk at a relaxed, steady pace without leaning forward.
Continue for 2-5 minutes at an easy to moderate effort.

11784.description: A squat jump while hanging from a bar that lets you focus on explosive leg drive.
instructions: Hang from a bar with arms straight and knees slightly bent.
Lower into a deep squat position.
Explode upward through your legs.
Absorb the movement softly and return to the start.
Keep your core tight and repeat.

0072.description: Lying face down on an incline bench, you curl the bar up. Works the biceps with a strict stretch at the bottom.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Lie face down on the bench with your chest and stomach resting against it.
Hold a barbell with an underhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms fully, allowing the barbell to hang down towards the floor.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the barbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
脸朝下躺在长凳上，胸部和腹部靠在长凳上。
反手握住杠铃，距离与肩同宽。
充分伸展双臂，让杠铃垂向地板。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起杠铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且杠铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0136.description: A seated yoga balance where you lift your legs and chest into a V shape. It builds core and hip flexor strength.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Lean back slightly while keeping your chest open.
Lift your feet off the floor and straighten your legs if you can.
Reach your arms forward alongside your knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower your feet gently to rest.

0200.description: A triceps pushdown with a rope. Splitting the rope at the bottom gives the triceps a strong squeeze.
instructions: Attach a rope attachment to a high pulley on a cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Grasp the rope with an overhand grip, palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Exhale and push the rope downward by extending your elbows until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position by allowing your elbows to flex.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳索附件连接到缆绳机上的高滑轮上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住绳子，手掌相对。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气并伸展肘部将绳子向下推，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后吸气，并让肘部弯曲，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0264.description: A jumping-jack variation where the arms and legs cross in front of the body. It raises your heart rate and coordination.
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Jump back crossing your arms and one leg in front.
Alternate which leg crosses on the next rep.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.

0328.description: An incline shoulder raise with dumbbells moving overhead. It works the shoulder blades and the serratus anterior.
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down.
Rest the dumbbells on your thighs and lean back onto the bench.
Use your thighs to help raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, then rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing forward.
Exhale and slowly raise the dumbbells above your head, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将上斜凳摆成 45 度角，坐在上面，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心朝下。
将哑铃放在大腿上，然后靠在长凳上。
用大腿帮助将哑铃举至肩膀高度，然后旋转手腕，使手掌朝前。
呼气，慢慢将哑铃举过头顶，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回肩部高度。
重复所需的重复次数。

0392.description: Sitting tall, you lift dumbbells to the front to shoulder height. It trains the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Raise the dumbbells in front of you, with your palms facing down, until they are at shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
保持背部挺直，核心参与。
将哑铃举到身前，手掌朝下，直到与肩同高。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0456.description: A sit-up with bent knees. It strengthens the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
At the same time, lift your legs off the ground, bending your knees and bringing them towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body and legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
同时，将双腿抬离地面，弯曲膝盖并将其拉向胸部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低上半身和双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0520.description: You press kettlebells overhead one after the other. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height.
Press one kettlebell overhead, fully extending your arm.
Lower the kettlebell back to shoulder height.
Repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个壶铃，与肩同高。
将一只壶铃按过头顶，完全伸展手臂。
将壶铃降低至肩膀高度。
用另一只手臂重复上述步骤。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

0584.description: On a lever machine, you raise your arms out to the sides against resistance. Isolates the side delts.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms straight.
Exhale and raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，背部靠在垫子上。
正手握住手柄并保持手臂伸直。
呼气并将手臂向两侧抬起，直到与地板平行。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0648.description: You pull the bar from the floor and catch it on your shoulders in a quarter squat. Builds explosive power in the legs, hips and back.
instructions: Start with the barbell on the ground in front of you, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend down and grip the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and chest up as you lift the barbell off the ground, extending your hips and knees.
As the barbell reaches your mid-thigh, explosively pull it upwards, shrugging your shoulders and pulling your elbows high and to the sides.
As the barbell reaches its highest point, quickly drop underneath it, rotating your elbows around and catching the barbell on your shoulders in a front squat position.
Stand up with the barbell, fully extending your hips and knees.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position, keeping control of the weight throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先将杠铃放在你面前的地面上，双脚分开与肩同宽。
弯腰，正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃提离地面时，保持背部挺直，挺胸，伸展臀部和膝盖。
当杠铃到达大腿中部时，爆发性地将其向上拉，耸肩并将肘部拉高并向两侧拉。
当杠铃到达最高点时，迅速下降到其下方，旋转肘部，以前蹲姿势将杠铃接在肩膀上。
握住杠铃站起来，充分伸展臀部和膝盖。
将杠铃放回起始位置，在整个运动过程中保持对重量的控制。
重复所需的重复次数。

0712.description: A side-lying lift of both feet at once. It works the inner thighs and the sides of the waist.
instructions: Lie on your side with legs straight.
Support your head with your arm.
Lift both feet off the floor together.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

0776.description: An Olympic lifting pull that drives the barbell from the floor to chest height with a powerful extension and shrug. It builds explosive power in the hips, legs and back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell on the ground in front of you.
Bend your knees and hinge at the hips to lower into a squat position, gripping the barbell with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and chest up as you drive through your heels to lift the barbell off the ground, extending your hips and knees.
As the barbell reaches hip level, explosively pull it upwards, shrugging your shoulders and pulling your elbows high and to the sides.
As the barbell reaches its highest point, quickly drop underneath it, pulling yourself into a deep squat position.
Catch the barbell overhead with your arms fully extended and your knees bent.
Stand up by extending your hips and knees, keeping the barbell overhead.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position by reversing the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，杠铃放在你面前的地面上。
弯曲膝盖并以臀部为铰链，降低至下蹲位置，用正手握住杠铃。
当你通过脚后跟将杠铃抬离地面时，保持背部挺直，挺胸，伸展臀部和膝盖。
当杠铃到达臀部水平时，爆发性地将其向上拉，耸肩并将肘部向两侧拉高。
当杠铃到达最高点时，迅速落到杠铃下方，将自己拉成深蹲位置。
双臂完全伸展，膝盖弯曲，将杠铃举过头顶。
伸展臀部和膝盖站起来，将杠铃保持在头顶上方。
通过反向运动将杠铃降低回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0840.description: A weighted crunch on a stability ball with the arms overhead. It trains the abs through a larger range of motion.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Engage your abs and slowly curl your torso forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your torso back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
双手握住杠铃片或哑铃，并将手臂伸过头顶。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向前弯曲躯干，使胸部靠近膝盖。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将躯干放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0968.description: A band curl alternating one arm at a time. It trains the biceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and slowly curl one arm up towards your shoulder, squeezing your biceps at the top.
Lower the arm back down to the starting position and repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，反手握住弹力带，手掌朝上。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，慢慢地将一只手臂向肩膀弯曲，在顶部挤压二头肌。
将手臂放回起始位置，然后用另一只手臂重复此动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。
